grammarFocus: 一般过去时；规则与常用不规则过去式；then / after that / finally。
title: A Weekend Trip to Hangzhou
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。请根据原文内容作答，不要加入自己的猜测。本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
Last month, Li Wei went to Hangzhou for a weekend trip. He took a fast train from Shanghai on Friday evening. The train left at 7:30 p.m. and arrived at 8:45 p.m. Li Wei felt excited because he wanted to see West Lake.

On Saturday morning, Li Wei got up early. First, he walked to West Lake. He took many photos of the lake and the boats. After that, he rented a bike and rode around the lake for two hours. He stopped at a small café and drank a cup of Longjing tea. Then, he visited a museum near the lake. The museum was free, and he learned about Hangzhou's history. In the afternoon, Li Wei met his friend, Zhang Min. They had lunch together at a noodle restaurant. Zhang Min paid for lunch because Li Wei forgot his wallet at the hotel. After lunch, they walked along a famous street and bought some gifts. Finally, Li Wei went back to his hotel at 5 p.m. He was tired but happy.

On Sunday, Li Wei visited a tea farm. He saw how farmers picked tea leaves. He also bought some tea for his family. He took the train back to Shanghai in the evening. The trip was short, but Li Wei enjoyed it very much. He hopes to visit Hangzhou again next year.

grammar.title: 一般过去时：规则与常用不规则动词；then / after that / finally
grammar.explanation: 一般过去时用来描述过去发生的动作或状态。规则动词的过去式通常在词尾加 -ed，例如 walk → walked, visit → visited。不规则动词的过去式需要单独记忆，例如 go → went, take → took, have → had, buy → bought, forget → forgot。表示顺序时，可以用 first, then, after that, finally 等词。
grammar.example: First, he walked to West Lake. After that, he rented a bike. Then, he visited a museum. Finally, he went back to his hotel.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: Yesterday, I ___ to the park.
questions.explanation: go 的过去式是 went，是不规则动词。
questions.evidence: go → went

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: She ___ a new dress last week.
questions.explanation: buy 的过去式是 bought，是不规则动词。
questions.evidence: buy → bought

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word to complete the sequence: First, we had breakfast. ___, we went to the beach.
questions.explanation: 表示顺序时用 then，意为“然后”。
questions.evidence: First, ... Then, ...

questions.prompt: Choose the correct past form: They ___ a movie last night.
questions.explanation: watch 是规则动词，过去式加 -ed 变成 watched。
questions.evidence: watch → watched
